blocks.html:
Effective Date: February 1, 2025

Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment (“we”, “our”, “us”) is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Cookies Policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies on our website www.goodwillstaffing.ca (“Website”).

By using our Website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy. If you do not agree with our use of cookies, please disable them by following the instructions in this policy.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your actions or preferences over time. Cookies are widely used to make websites work efficiently and to provide the website owner with information about how the site is being used.

Types of Cookies We Use

We use the following types of cookies on our Website:

1. Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the functioning of our Website. Without them, certain parts of the Website may not work. For example, these cookies allow you to log in to secure areas or complete transactions.

2. Performance Cookies

Performance cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our Website, providing insights into which pages are visited most and whether users experience errors. These cookies do not collect personal information and are used to improve the performance and functionality of the Website.

3. Functionality Cookies

Functionality cookies allow the Website to remember choices you make, such as your language or region, and provide enhanced, more personalized features. These cookies are used to provide a better user experience but are not essential for the functioning of the Website.

4. Targeting or Advertising Cookies

Targeting cookies are used to track your browsing behavior across different websites. These cookies help us deliver more relevant advertising and marketing content to you. They are typically placed by third-party advertising networks with our permission.

Third-Party Cookies

We may also allow third-party service providers (such as Google Analytics or social media platforms) to set cookies on our Website. These cookies may be used to track user behavior across different sites or services and help third parties deliver targeted content or ads.

For more information on third-party cookies, please refer to the privacy policies of these providers.

How to Manage Cookies

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most web browsers allow you to:

  • Accept or block cookies
  • Delete cookies
  • Receive notifications when a cookie is being set

For more information on how to manage cookies in your browser, visit the help section of your browser. Please note that if you block or delete cookies, some parts of our Website may not function properly.

Browser Instructions:

  • Google Chrome: Manage Cookies in Chrome
  • Mozilla Firefox: Manage Cookies in Firefox
  • Microsoft Edge: Manage Cookies in Edge

Changes to This Cookies Policy

We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we are using cookies.
